description: The wielder of the divine twin guns known as "Rickel" is said to have given up her own name to the guns in exchange for amazing abilities. Had she been able to continue fighting in Grand Gaia and learned to fully control the divine twin guns, she would have earned back her real name. Her story hence be quite different, as Rickel would have then granted its wielder all of its great power upon having found her worthy.
summon:
I finally got my name back.
That can only mean that Rickel and I
have grown even closer!
fusion:
You ask me what has changed?
Well, nothing!
Rickel and I are still one and the same.
evolution:
Finally, my name's been acknowledged!
I'm Millie, Rickel's actually my partner.
